describe.summary: Move video files between works. Which work a file belongs to is decided by collection membership, not by where it sits on disk, so this (not video.file.move) is how a movie filed as "season 0" of a series is fixed: to=standalone makes each file its own work (then video.work.identify it with type=movie and video.files.organize to rename), to=new groups the files into a new work, to=collection:<id> moves them into an existing work. The old work's episode bindings and manual pins for these files are cleared, and later scans do not pull them back. Files the user added to the collection by hand are skipped. Refuses to move every member out of a work.
